title: Automation Contract & Chain Schema
brief: Define automation-chain JSON schema, event-to-chain mapping, command-to-chain mapping, downgrade/fail-closed behavior, telemetry event schema. Per-chain token budgets (entry router <500 tokens, coding chain <2K, product autopilot <5K).

units.title: Define automation-chain JSON schema with chain-id, steps, triggers, and token-budget fields
Define event-to-chain mapping (hook events to automation chains) and command-to-chain mapping (slash commands to chains)
Define downgrade/fail-closed behavior rules per chain tier (silent degrade, user prompt, hard stop)
Define telemetry event schema (fire timestamp, chain-id, step-id, token cost, latency, outcome)
Define per-chain token budgets (entry router <500, coding chain <2K, product autopilot <5K) and budget enforcement contract

exit_conditions: automation-chain JSON schema frozen and validated
Downgrade/fail-closed rules defined for all chain tiers
Per-chain token budgets documented with enforcement rules
